component.name: MarkdownBláthy
component.summary: Markdown editor with Typst-powered live preview and PDF export

description.p: MarkdownBláthy is a desktop Markdown editor with live preview and on-demand PDF export. The preview and the PDF are produced by the same Typst compilation pipeline, so what you see is what you get.

Write in Markdown with CommonMark, GitHub Flavored Markdown, or a Custom flavor that adds footnotes, LaTeX-style math, task lists, and more. The split-screen layout shows the rendered pages on the right as you type.
Export to PDF with one click, restyle everything with a custom Typst template, and keep your settings between sessions.
The name commemorates Ottó Titusz Bláthy who among his other inventions became the co-inventor of the efficient alternating current transformer.
